lead: Pins an element to the edge of its scroll container once it scrolls out of view, and releases it when it is back in place. While pinned, a placeholder of the same size keeps its spot, so the page doesn't jump. Without `target` it follows the whole window.

demo.filler: Placeholder content that makes the container scrollable.

bottom.title: Bottom
bottom.description: With `offsetBottom` the element starts below the visible area: it is pinned to the bottom of the box and released when you scroll to its place.
bottom.hint: (it starts below: pinned to the bottom of the box, released once you scroll to its place)

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: Theme styles handle it in `affix.css`. It is about positioning, not looks, so it is the same in every theme style.
styling.affix: The placeholder: while pinned it takes the content's height, so the page doesn't jump; `data-affixed`. Position and size are written to its `--affix-top` / `left` / `w` / `h` (pixels, no unit)
styling.content: The content: gets `data-affixed` and `position: fixed` while pinned. Use it to add a shadow or a background to the pinned state
